name: Agitators
summary: Agitators is an early task on Zephras Isle issued by Yala Windwatcher. The aggressive Al'Aketh cult has pushed into Thendal Grove, agitating the peaceful native wind sprites into hostile elementals. Adventurers are sent to disperse the roiling winds and clear out the cultist converts threatening the area.

sections.title: Disturbing the Grove
sections.body: Thendal Grove has fallen under the shadow of the Al'Aketh cult. Known for their unsettling designs on Zephras Isle, the cultists have encroached on the grove and actively riled the delicate wind spirits dwelling there. Once peaceful sprites have turned violent, forming volatile roiling winds that threaten anyone passing through the region.

sections.title: A Painful Necessity
sections.body: Yala Windwatcher tasks passing champions with subduing both the enraged elementals and the Al'Aketh converts fomenting the unrest. While putting down the wind creatures restores a fragile calm to the grove, dealing with the cultists is a somber duty: Yala laments the shedding of shen'dorei blood among their own people, yet recognizes that the cult leaves little choice.

faq.answer: Yala Windwatcher offers the quest in the vicinity of Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: What is the Al'Aketh cult doing in Thendal Grove?
faq.answer: The Al'Aketh cult has moved into the grove and agitated the native wind spirits, driving the peaceful creatures into a hostile, violent frenzy.
They are simple, native wind sprites of Zephras Isle that have been stirred up and corrupted into aggressive elemental whirlwinds by the Al'Aketh cultists.

faq.q: Why is Yala Windwatcher saddened by killing the converts?
faq.answer: Yala laments having to shed shen'dorei blood in the grove, showing that the Al'Aketh converts belong to their own people who have fallen sway to dangerous cult teachings.

aliases: where do i go after agitators
faq.answer: After finishing Agitators for Yala Windwatcher, you are directed to continue your duties in the quest Return to Rorian.

faq.q: Where does this conflict take place?
faq.answer: The conflict is centered in Thendal Grove, located on the island of Zephras Isle.

angles.text: Witnessing natural wind sprites driven to violent frenzy by cultist meddling is an offense against elemental balance that demands intervention.
The desecration of Thendal Grove's natural harmony by rogue cultists makes the defense of its native spirits an urgent priority.
